findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.

EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
findings.explanation: Your liability is capped, but your obligations under Paragraph 9 (which appears to refer to indemnification or similar obligations) are entirely excluded from that cap, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: Contractor's maximum liability to Company arising for any reason relating to Contractor's performance of services under a Statement of Work shall be limited to the amount of fees paid to Contractor for the performance of such services, without exception.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before signing. Specifically, regarding the relevant clause: - Your liability is capped, but your obligations under Paragraph 9 (which appears to refer to indemnification or similar obligations) are entirely excluded from that cap, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for those claims; please update this to: Contractor's maximum liability to Company arising for any reason relating to Contractor's performance of services under a Statement of Work shall be limited to the amount of fees paid to Contractor for the performance of such services, without exception. Thank you for considering these updates. Best regards,
